analogy.rationale: PLCB/PLCG and PLA2 enzymes are broadly expressed but their activation produces only modest, cell-type-dependent transcriptional changes in these lines, so the response is expected to be weak; no reference class shares the phospholipase-activation mechanism directly, and the closest functional neighbors (other lipid-signaling or calcium/PKC-linked classes) would only partially overlap.
